overall_assessment: Reviewed all 16 sampled courses (14 suspects, 2 controls) and all 21 attendance appendix items: 19 correct moves and 2 wrong moves (ATT 11 and ATT 15, cut at jf./Jf.); no residual or duplicated attendance requirements were visible in the sampled sections. Most boilerplate flags reflect legitimate shared didactics text, while the short/duplicate flags expose English-version placeholders; unflagged defects include teaching arrangements filed as content, prior-course requirements filed as coursework, and a Canvas notice retained as coursework. Learning-outcome groups and assessment designs are retained and the controls otherwise split cleanly, but packet-builder truncation limits completeness comparisons; PHS/FHS fixes cannot be assessed from this hivolda-only packet.

findings.evidence: Ein del av undervisninga i emnet vert gitt under overskrifta Felles fagdidaktikk, medan i andre delar av undervisninga vil studenten vere i eigne undervisningsgrupper
findings.description: All 12 sampled Didaktikk 2 plans retain paragraphs about common versus subject-specific teaching groups and participation, supervision, literature study and assignment writing in course_content. Those passages describe how students are taught and work, and belong in teaching_methods. The subject-matter and pedagogical aims around them should remain as appropriate; the boilerplate flag is not itself a reason to discard shared academic text. This recurring defect is concentrated in the didactics cluster, not demonstrated institution-wide by the controls.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: R/institution_config.R maps the entire hivolda field-course-content block to course_content. Subsequent splitting handles coursework gates but does not relocate these identifiable teaching-arrangement paragraphs embedded under Om emnet.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a hivolda-specific paragraph relocation in R/extract_sections.R for the observed Ein del av undervisninga ... Felles fagdidaktikk variants and the associated Studentar med undervisningskompetanse ... paragraph. Append them to teaching_methods once and remove them from course_content, preserving surrounding subject-matter text.

findings.description: All 12 sampled Didaktikk 2 plans file the requirement to have passed the preceding didactics course under coursework_requirements. This is a prior-course prerequisite by the codebook, not a current-course assignment or activity requiring approval. prerequisites currently contains only the separate requirement to have completed the earlier course's mandatory teaching and learning activities, so the passed-course condition is missing from its proper section.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The hivolda field-assessment-requirements block is assigned wholesale to coursework_requirements because it appears under Vilkår for å framstille seg til eksamen; the cleaner does not distinguish a prior-course condition inside that block.
findings.suggested_fix: Relocate the exact standalone Bestått didaktikkemne 1. sentence from hivolda coursework_requirements to prerequisites in R/extract_sections.R, preserving the existing prerequisite sentence and all current-course attendance and assignment requirements.

findings.description: Both design plans emit prerequisites, course_content and teaching_methods consisting only of the English-version pointer; learning_outcomes contains that pointer plus empty Kunnskapar/Ferdigheiter/Generell kompetanse groups and dashes. These rows provide no section content and should be absent under course_plan_spec.md. The short/dup_in_course flags therefore identify real placeholder contamination rather than duplicated substantive content. The exam-table assessment rows do contain real assessment design and should be retained.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: R/extract_sections.R .placeholder_phrases recognizes see english version and some Bokmål variants, but omits Sjå engelsk versjon. The remaining empty learning-outcome labels also prevent the combined block from being recognized as empty.
findings.suggested_fix: Add an anchored (?:se|sjå) engelsk versjon placeholder variant and suppress learning-outcome rows whose remaining text consists solely of group headings and placeholder marks. Resolve English-page pointers upstream where possible, while retaining the valid assessment table during section cleanup.

findings.evidence: Studenter plikter å holde seg orientert om aktuelle beskjeder fra faglærere via Canvas.
findings.description: The random photo-course control retains a general instruction to monitor Canvas in coursework_requirements. It names no work, participation or attendance that must be approved before the exam, and belongs only in the full plan. The surrounding attendance rule and three explicitly required arbeidskrav are valid, including the evaluation explicitly identified as one of those requirements.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The complete hivolda field-assessment-requirements block is retained, and .section_noise has no hivolda pattern excluding this general communication notice.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a narrow hivolda .section_noise pattern for the quoted standalone Canvas-monitoring notice in R/extract_sections.R; keep it in course_plan and preserve the adjoining attendance rule and assignment list in coursework_requirements.
